settings.agents.title: Agents
settings.agents.npmPackage: npm package (auto-install if not in PATH)
settings.agents.npmPackagePlaceholder: Leave empty for native ACP agents
settings.agents.reference: Command is the executable OmniTerm spawns and talks to over ACP (stdio). Arguments are passed as argv, space-separated. Environment variables are injected into the process. An agent must speak the ACP protocol over its stdio — point Command at an ACP-compatible client (e.g. an agent CLI with an ACP mode).
settings.agents.installHint: Presets with an npm package field are auto-installed on first use if not found in PATH. Your own globally/local installed binaries always take priority.
settings.agents.preset.claude.label: Claude Code
settings.agents.preset.claude.hint: Claude Code CLI ships no ACP mode; uses the community adapter @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp (official Agent SDK) via npx.
settings.agents.preset.codex.label: Codex
settings.agents.preset.codex.hint: Codex CLI has no built-in ACP; uses the community adapter @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp via npx.
settings.agents.preset.gemini.label: Gemini CLI
settings.agents.preset.gemini.hint: Spawns the Gemini CLI in ACP mode (--experimental-acp).
settings.agents.preset.opencode.label: OpenCode
settings.agents.preset.qwen.label: Qwen Code

settings.agents.preset.kiro.label: Kiro

settings.agents.preset.qoder.label: qoder
settings.agents.preset.qoder.hint: Spawns the Qoder CLI in ACP mode (--acp).
settings.agents.preset.qoderCn.label: qoder cn
settings.agents.preset.qoderCn.hint: Spawns the Qoder CLI (CN) in ACP mode (--acp).
settings.agents.preset.piAcp.label: Pi ACP
settings.agents.preset.piAcp.hint: Pi ACP has no built-in ACP; spawns the community adapter pi-acp via npx (https://github.com/svkozak/pi-acp).
